description: One account for each person across all apps: a shared learner identity database with a session cookie on .reading-advantage.com for students and teachers, and the existing company identity with a role per app for staff. Reading starts on shared accounts; Primary users move after that. Code starts after the Primary cutover and the end of the feature freeze.
deviation_notes: Owner chose option B1 plus company staff in all apps on 2026-10-09, and decided OD-1 to OD-5 (OD-5 depends on a licence model check). A Fable subagent reviewed the first draft; all 16 findings are in the spec and the plan. Owner decided OD-6 on 2026-10-10: Reading has no public self sign-up.
